messages:
jamie_support: FYI we're getting multiple CS escalations — customers see invoice token counts much higher than dashboard and expected usage. appears to start around 2026-07-01 02:00 UTC. investigating.
sara_ops: saw the same alert. metering ingestion showed a backlog for ~3h then a shortcut replay job ran but looks truncated.
metering-bot: ALERT: ingestion-lag > 2h on metering-ingest-prod for partition=us-east-1, window=2026-07-01T02:00:00Z..2026-07-01T05:00:00Z
oncall-bot: Incident created: MET-2026-07-01-BILLING-DELTA assigned to @sara_ops and @lee_engineering
lee_engineering: I dug into the event stream; there was a transient Kafka consumer group rebalance at ~02:12 UTC, consumer lag peaked. replay-worker retried but hit an OOM and exited at 02:45 UTC. looks like partial replay left gaps.
jamie_support: customer reports invoice shows 1.2M tokens for 2026-07-01 while dashboard shows ~300k. we need an estimate of missing/duplicated tokens and plan to reconcile invoices.
lee_engineering: steps to verify token counts:
1) run aggregate token counts from events table: `select date_trunc('hour', event_time) as hr, sum(tokens) from metering.events where event_time between '2026-07-01' and '2026-07-02' group by hr;`
2) compare against billing. I'll run a diff and post.

(sara_ops runs):
```
-- quick check
select hr, sum from tmp_hourly_events order by hr;
2026-07-01T00:00Z | 280000
2026-07-01T01:00Z | 300000
2026-07-01T02:00Z | 150000    -- partial ingest
2026-07-01T03:00Z | 130000    -- partial
2026-07-01T04:00Z | 400000    -- replay seemed to double some batches
```

lee_engineering: interesting — replay introduced duplication for 04:00 window. I think the replay tool retried the same kafka offsets without idempotency. root cause: replay-worker's dedupe-key was unset when the job restarted after OOM.
jamie_support: can we compute delta per customer so we can show customers the adjustment plan? Finance wants totals by org id.
lee_engineering: yes. I ran a script to compute per-org delta. snippet:
```
-- pseudo
select org_id, sum(tokens) as events_tokens, billing_report.tokens as billed_tokens,
       sum(tokens) - billing_report.tokens as delta
from metering.events e
join billing.report r on e.org_id = r.org_id and date = '2026-07-01'
group by org_id, billing_report.tokens;
```
Posting top 5 orgs with largest positive delta:
org_664 | +880k tokens
org_123 | +540k tokens
org_981 | +120k tokens

alex_m: I'm on customer comms. We'll need statement + provisional credit process. Finance needs final reconciliation before issuing refunds/credits. SLA to customers: provide an initial breakdown within 24h, final within 5 business days.
sara_ops: replay plan: we'll re-run the backfill/replay for range 2026-07-01T02:00:00Z..2026-07-01T05:00:00Z with idempotency fixes. using replay-tool v2.4.1 which adds dedupe key: `--dedupe-by event_id`.
Command:
```
replay-tool run --start 2026-07-01T02:00:00Z --end 2026-07-01T05:00:00Z --parallel 8 --dedupe-by event_id --verify-checksum
```

lee_engineering: before running, snapshot current table and take a checksum so we can verify. checksum script:
```
select md5(string_agg(id||'|'||tokens, ',' order by id)) from metering.events where event_time between '2026-07-01T02:00:00Z' and '2026-07-01T05:00:00Z';
```
Store as before_checksum. After replay, run again and compare.
metering-bot: NOTE: replay-job queued on replay-node-3. Estimated runtime ~40m.
sara_ops: kickstarting replay now. will stream logs here. tagging @alex_m for comms.

(sara_ops logs):
```
[2026-07-01T06:15:02Z] replay-tool: shards=8 assigned
[2026-07-01T06:18:10Z] replay-tool: processed 40% (1.2M events)
[2026-07-01T06:38:44Z] replay-tool: verify-checksum mismatch on shard-5, retrying
[2026-07-01T06:45:01Z] replay-tool: completed with warnings; dedupe applied
```

lee_engineering: ran post-replay diff. results show net +0 tokens for most orgs; duplicates removed. A few orgs had missing events still (likely lost before ingestion). I'll list the orgs and counts.

lee_engineering: remaining true deficits:
org_777 | -32k tokens
org_420 | -8k tokens
org_314 | -900 tokens

jamie_support: for those orgs do we plan to apply credit? how are we computing customer-visible adjustments — do we show token-level or monetary?
alex_m: Finance prefers monetary adjustments. use our per-token price tier mapping to convert tokens -> USD, then create provisional adjustments flagged "pending audit". I'll open a finance ticket.

(lee_engineering): action items I'm assigning:
- create audit-friendly CSV: org_id, window_start, window_end, pre_replay_tokens, post_replay_tokens, delta, usd_adjustment
- confirm lost-events search for pre-ingest failures (possible S3 missing upload)
- add a permanent guardrail to replay-tool to never run without `--dedupe-by` and fail early if config missing.
sara_ops: running the CSV export now; ETA 30m

metering-bot: EXPORT_COMPLETE: /exports/metering/reconciliations/2026-07-01-replay-delta.csv

jamie_support: thanks. I'll draft the initial customer message and post to #billing-ops for review. message will state: root cause (ingestion/replay gap), what we fixed (dedupe + replay), and expected next steps (monetary adjustments pending audit).
alex_m: please include a short FAQ: "Why did my invoice increase?" and "How we calculate the credit". Attach the CSV for internal review only.

lee_engineering: follow-up: we found a related micro-metric — replay-workers weren't honoring consumer group commit when OOM happened. created GH issue: infra/replay#452. will PR a fix today.

jamie_support: thanks team. I'll send interim notes to affected customers within 3 hours and update this thread with customer responses. closing for now but keeping thread live for updates.
